notes.title: Live Stream
notes.content: Live Stream of Elementowers gameplay and Q&A with developers.

notes.title: Rework mana collection mechanics
notes.content:
We have reviewed your feedback and decided to update demo version with new mana collection mechanics. We agree that is was really boring to hold down the spacebar during a large part of the game. Now you can collect mana [b]instantly[/b] when you run trough the orbs. This is a completely different experience. Check it out right now!

We also tweaked the balance to make the game a little easier on Easy and Normal modes. And fixed some bugs. Thanks for your feedback!
